items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: Sergeant Tucker had the band... He played trombone on all of my records that I made.

ctx.x: Joe was the one that's living.
That's living, yeah, John's dead. And when he came back he left here and went with the 8th Regiment band to the Army. And when he came back, he came back and Sergeant Tucker had the band.
He was a good trombone player then.
